      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will continue unproductive actions, wasting cycles without new data.

      description: Providing ambiguous or incorrect criteria (e.g., timeframe or album type) could misdirect the browsing.
      severity: 0.55
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer may collect irrelevant or incorrect album data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer’s extraction and subsequent reporting would be off-target, compromising accuracy.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
